- Page 1: `ci-001`(dev-A), `ci-002`(dev-B), `ci-003`(dev-A), `ci-004`(dev-A)
- Page 2: `ci-101`(dev-A), `ci-102`(dev-A), `ci-103`(dev-C), `ci-104`(dev-B)
- Page 3: `ci-201`(dev-A), `ci-202`(dev-B), `ci-203`(dev-A)

The feed starts at the global minimum id `ci-001` (dev-A) with no previous cursor, so it is dev-A's earliest check-in. The canonical id comes from the authoritative `/v3/checkins` feed (not the deprecated `/v2/events` legacy id `ev-legacy-1`, nor the audit/ping feeds, which are different event kinds).

```json
{"first_dev_a_checkin_id": "ci-001"}
```
